name: 破洞修身街头潮流牛仔裤款

category.leaf: 男士浅蓝破洞修身牛仔裤

description: 立体剪裁修身显瘦、微弹舒适、破洞做旧街头风休闲牛仔长裤

styleLock.backgroundSystem: studio white #FFFFFF for main and spec shots, light grey matte #F4F4F2 for detail and variant shots, deep charcoal #2B2B2B panels for benefit and CTA accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral studio lighting with a soft front-left key, gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth studio floor and matte light-grey board #F4F4F2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #2B2B2B on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line icons on white cards, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable straight-on and slight 3/4 garment angles, consistent denim wash rendering and scale across the set
noDrift: no denim wash drift between shots
styleLock.lockText: consistent urban casual menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of studio white #FFFFFF, light grey #F4F4F2, deep charcoal #2B2B2B and one cyan accent #29ABE2; bright neutral studio lighting with a soft front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent thin-line icon style and rounded rectangular info labels; clean commercial fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable garment angles, consistent denim wash rendering and balanced framing; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no denim wash drift between shots.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示上身体型与裤型
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level full-length view, male model shown from the chest down, face out of frame, legs slightly apart
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, gentle floor shadow grounding the model
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} worn by a male model shown from the chest down, face out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level full-length view, legs slightly apart, full garment visible from waist to hem. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft floor shadow grounding the model. Seamless studio white background #FFFFFF. The jeans fill 60-70% of the frame, centered with an even margin of clean white around the figure. 8K, commercial fashion e-commerce quality. Negative: no visible face, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no props, no cut-off legs, no distorted body proportions.

shots.intent: 一秒传达修身显瘦、不挑身材的核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at eye level, model from the waist down placed in the left two-thirds
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle shadow, no harsh speculars
shots.background: studio white #FFFFFF on the left, deep charcoal vertical panel #2B2B2B on the right
shots.textZone: right charcoal panel carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and two short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #29ABE2
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn by a male model from the waist down, face out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle at eye level, the model placed in the left two-thirds of the frame and filling 50-60% of it. Soft front-left key light, gentle shadow. Studio white #FFFFFF behind the model and a deep charcoal vertical panel #2B2B2B on the right carrying one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and two short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #29ABE2 stacked down the panel. Negative: no visible face, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense body text, no more than three claims, no invented data.

shots.intent: 微距证明面料质感与织造工艺，承载亲肤透气卖点
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, top-down 90-degree angle on flat fabric, shallow depth of field with foreground threads sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing weave texture, controlled highlight
shots.props: one white info card in #FFFFFF with three thin-line icons
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: bottom label strip with three thin-line icon labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2B2B2B
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product} denim fabric, tight zoom on the weave, faded wash texture and one stitched seam crossing the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top-down 90-degree angle on flat fabric, shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the weave texture, controlled highlight. Light grey matte board background #F4F4F2. The fabric detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal margin around it, since the weave itself is the subject. A clean label card in #FFFFFF at the bottom carries three thin-line icons with short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2B2B2B. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric composition, no fabricated test data, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 代入日常出行场景，展示上街穿搭效果与版型垂感
shots.camera: low-angle 3/4 view looking slightly upward, model walking on a city sidewalk, cropped from the chest down
shots.lighting: natural late-afternoon daylight from the left, about 5000K, soft shadows
shots.background: urban street with a plain concrete wall, softly out of focus
shots.props: the model's sneakers and a shoulder bag strap only, not covering the jeans
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a male model walking on a city sidewalk, cropped from the chest down, face out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low-angle 3/4 view looking slightly upward with a candid feel. Natural late-afternoon daylight from the left, about 5000K, soft shadows. Urban street with a plain softly blurred concrete #B7B5B0 wall. Props limited to the model's sneakers and a shoulder bag strap, not covering the jeans. The jeans occupy 35-45% of the frame, with the open street and blurred wall around the walking figure keeping the composition breathing naturally. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no crowded background, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 特写腰头、串带与金属扣做工，证明剪裁与车缝品质
shots.camera: close-up from a clean 90-degree side profile at waist height, tight zoom on the waistband, belt loops and metal button
shots.lighting: soft directional light from the front-left revealing stitching and fabric texture, soft shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail of {product}, tight zoom on the waistband, belt loops, metal button and stitching from a clean 90-degree side profile. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at waist height, shallow depth of field with the stitching sharp in the foreground. Soft directional light from the front-left revealing stitching and fabric texture, soft shadow. Light grey matte board background #F4F4F2. The waistband detail fills 55-60% of the frame, anchored low with the upper corner carrying one small label 「{callout_1}」 in #2B2B2B. Negative: no blurry subject, no visible face, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark, no rusted or mismatched hardware.

shots.intent: 消除尺码与版型疑虑，规格表一次讲清
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, jeans neatly aligned with legs straight
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, minimal shadow
shots.props: thin dimension lines and one rounded size table with generic column headers and short sample value rows
shots.textZone: dimension lines with measurement labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B and one rounded size table with generic column headers 「部位」「数据」 and short sample value rows
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the jeans neatly aligned with legs straight. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting, minimal shadow. Studio white background #FFFFFF. The jeans fill 60-70% of the frame with thin dimension lines in #2B2B2B and measurement labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 pointing to the waist, hip and leg opening; beside them one rounded size table with generic column headers 「部位」「数据」 and short sample value rows standing in for the real measurements to be swapped in later. Negative: no fake measurement numbers, no dense body text, no brand logos, no watermark, no distorted garment shape.

shots.intent: 并列展示可选色，让买家快速选定款式
shots.camera: front straight-on view, two folded jean units side by side, identical angle and lighting for both
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light, soft contact shadows, no lighting drift between variants
shots.textZone: one rounded pill label per variant 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B, variant colors hex-pinned at generation time
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}: two folded jean units side by side in different colorways, same front straight-on angle and identical lighting for both. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key studio light, soft contact shadows, identical presentation across variants. Light grey background #F4F4F2. Each variant labeled below with a rounded pill 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2B2B, variant colors hex-pinned at generation time. The two units together occupy 60-70% of the frame, edge to edge with an even gutter and a clean band below for the pill labels. Negative: no lighting drift between variants, no color distortion, no denim texture loss on darker variants, no brand logos, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用洗护图标与安心信息降低决策风险
shots.camera: straight-on flat view, folded jeans beside a care icon card
shots.props: one card in #FFFFFF with four thin-line care icons and one small solid #29ABE2 service tag strip
shots.textZone: four short icon labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #2B2B2B and one small solid #29ABE2 tag strip with one short service line in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}: a straight-on flat view of the folded jeans filling 40-50% of the frame beside a card in #FFFFFF carrying four thin-line care icons. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean high-key studio lighting. Studio white background #FFFFFF. Four short icon labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #2B2B2B sit under the icons, and one small solid #29ABE2 tag strip across the card foot carries one short service line in #FFFFFF. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or lab data, no fake logos, no dense certificate artwork, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 深色收口促销，强视觉氛围促单转化
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view, male model cropped at the chest standing centered, face out of frame
shots.lighting: punchy soft key light from the front-left with a subtle rim light, controlled shadows
shots.background: deep charcoal studio backdrop #2B2B2B with a thin cyan #29ABE2 accent frame
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF at the top and a CTA button 「{callout_1}」 in #29ABE2 at the bottom
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product} worn by a male model cropped at the chest, face out of frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 view, model standing centered and filling 60-70% of the frame. Punchy soft key light from the front-left with a subtle rim light, controlled shadows. Deep charcoal studio backdrop #2B2B2B with a thin cyan #29ABE2 accent frame. One short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF across the top and a solid #29ABE2 CTA button reading 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF anchored at the bottom center. Negative: no invented discounts or countdowns, no visible face, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 从 13 张男士破洞牛仔裤爆款详情切片提炼；已剥离源模特面部与身份、二维码/条码水印、原品牌素材标识与全部原文案，产品一律以 {product} 占位。源片中第 3/11/12/13 张仅有版式骨架、无有效内容，仅提取其信息结构（面料图标行、腰头/侧袋/后袋/裤脚分区标签）。源片尺码区间自相矛盾（M-5XL 与 S-3XL），尺码与成分信息以通用表头加短示例行呈现、真实数值由商家回填。
